limitations: All controls are driven through the served SPA with a real Chromium browser; requests are captured from the page's own traffic at the moment of the action.
Client-side-only controls (tabs, filters, validation, modal open/cancel) legitimately issue no network request; they are marked E2E_PASS on an observed DOM state change.
Confirm-gated destructive controls are either driven to a full stage->confirm settle or cancelled cleanly; config save is a net-zero round-trip (the loaded tree is re-submitted unchanged).
E2E_SKIP marks controls not safely executable (operator/external or destructive-avoid), not failures.
The MCP catalog install and env/oauth/provider writes are not executed (operator-gated / would mutate user data).
The artifact's only volatile field is generated_at.
